lede: Hernando celebrates Christmas around its Historic Hernando Square, with a chamber parade, Cookies with Santa from the city, a wildlife themed Christmas at The Ark and Santa meals at Cedar Hill Farm.
celebrates: The Hernando Main Street Chamber of Commerce leads the season with Hernando Dickens of a Christmas in mid November and then the Hernando Christmas Parade along Commerce Street and the Historic Hernando Square. Hernando Parks and Recreation hosts Cookies with Santa at the Gale Community Center. Mississippi Wildlife Rehabilitation holds Critter Christmas at The Ark with Santa, Buddy the Elf and ambassador animals, and Cedar Hill Farm serves breakfast, brunch and dinner with Santa in its barn. The farm also runs a choose and cut Christmas tree farm from November 21 to December 19.
lastyear: In 2025 Hernando Dickens of a Christmas ran on Saturday, November 22, from 9 am to 7 pm around the Historic Hernando Square with live performances, ice skating, family friendly arts and crafts, trolley rides and markets, according to the listing for the Shell on Wheels stop in Hernando. The chamber's 2026 Dickens weekend was November 13 and 14, and the city says a Christmas Farmers Market ran in conjunction on November 14.
facts: Hernando is home to the headquarters of First Regional Library, which sits inside the Hernando branch about 20 miles south of Memphis. Cedar Hill Farm is a 120 acre working farm with a restaurant called The Barn, and for 2026 it chose a simpler season, dropping the paid train ride and synchronized light show while keeping Santa meals and the tree farm. The Gale Center, home of Hernando Parks and Recreation, was renovated in 2008.
trains: Hernando families who want trains can look at the antique Marx O Gauge train set on display at Critter Christmas at The Ark. Cedar Hill Farm says it is not running its paid Christmas train ride in 2026. Memphis is the closest rail attraction: the Memphis Railroad and Trolley Museum fills a ground floor suite of Central Station, and the MATA Trolley has run vintage and replica streetcars downtown since 1993.

faq: When does Hernando hold its Christmas parade?

The Hernando Main Street Chamber of Commerce holds a Christmas parade each December along Commerce Street and the Historic Hernando Square. The chamber picks a new theme every year, and the city's annual events page lists the parade and invites families to bring everyone and line up.
Can kids meet Santa in Hernando?

Yes, in several places. Hernando Parks and Recreation hosts Cookies with Santa at the Gale Community Center, Mississippi Wildlife Rehabilitation brings Santa and Buddy the Elf to Critter Christmas at The Ark, and Cedar Hill Farm offers a Santa visit with its brunch and dinner days.
Does Cedar Hill Farm have Christmas lights or a train ride?

Not in 2026. The farm's Christmas Traditions page says it is not offering the paid Christmas train ride or the synchronized outdoor light show this year. It does decorate the barns with lights and runs a choose and cut tree farm and Santa meals.
What is Hernando Dickens of a Christmas?

It is the chamber's holiday weekend on the Historic Hernando Square. The 2025 listing described live performances, ice skating, arts and crafts, trolley rides and markets, and the 2026 weekend took place November 13 and 14, before the rest of the Christmas events here.
